settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subheading: Everything you need to know about our mower delivery, warranty, and authentic equipment.

settings.question: How does freight delivery with hydraulic liftgate work?
settings.answer: All riding mowers and lawn tractors ship securely crated via specialized LTL freight carriers with complimentary residential liftgate service. The carrier will contact you in advance to schedule a delivery appointment window and lowers the crate safely onto your driveway.

settings.question: Are all mowers authentic, brand-new, and covered by warranty?
settings.answer: Yes, 100%. Every piece of equipment in the Leafanoo catalog is brand-new, factory-sealed, and backed by manufacturer specifications, official GTIN/UPC barcodes, and full factory warranty coverage approved by US standards.

settings.question: Does the mower arrive assembled?
settings.answer: Mowers arrive 95% assembled in heavy-duty shipping crates. Final setup (attaching the steering wheel/handles and connecting the battery terminal) takes only 15–20 minutes with basic household tools. Full setup instructions and manuals are inside the crate.

settings.question: Can I speak to someone before ordering?
settings.answer: Absolutely! Our turf equipment specialists are available via live chat (Chatty) on the bottom right or toll-free at +1 (800) 614-2395 to answer questions about cutting decks, engine HP, and property recommendations.
